answer: Pair every active agent at a random synchronized instant into a liveness duel: both must answer a fresh challenge within one second. A sybil fleet on one backend cannot be in two duels at once — rigid as a glacier, its extra masks queue and miss the clock. Colluding kin betray themselves too, their paired transcripts clustering in one tight nebula the auditor flags. To field N identities an attacker must run N genuinely parallel inference pipelines, as distinct as separate cedar trees — linear compute per fake, not one engine wearing many masks.
